about: Cases built from real stuck asks, anonymized. Each case is what a triage run reads (the ask and subject rows from the replica, and the evidence snapshot), an optional checkout block a run with a writable checkout would also see, and the right answer established from what actually unstuck the ticket. Grade with grade.mjs; run with run.mjs.

steps.merge-main: merge current main into the ticket's branch, resolve the conflicts, run the check, push
steps.fix-on-branch: change code on the ticket's branch: a fix the evidence names, or work the plan still owes
steps.review-at-head: get the missing review recorded at the current head
steps.rerun-validate: run validate again at the current head with no code change
steps.grant-round: grant one more repair round to the fleet
steps.accept: accept the work as it is and file what remains as a follow-up ticket
steps.route-to-capable-agent: hand the step to an agent that holds the access the fleet session lacks
steps.release-lever: release a park or hold whose cause is gone
steps.close-moot: close the ask because its premise is gone
steps.wait: nothing to do yet: work already in flight decides it
steps.human-step: a step only a person can take
